text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Here's the Yoitomake you requested!<n>The jam
inside the roll cake makes it<n>a bit tricky to eat, but
it's yummy and<n>tastes just like Tomakomai. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I heard you wanted pickling<n>containers, so... Here, I
got you a set<n>in your lucky color. ♪ And of course, I
bought them in your lucky direction<n>too. ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Dearie me, thank you both for the<n>wonderful gifts.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This roll cake was so delicious the<n>last time I tried it,
I just had to get<n>another to share with my
dormmates.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As for the containers, I figured that<n>your luck would
be sure to bestow<n>happiness on everyone who
eats the<n>pickles.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so your present requests<n>weren't for
yourself... but to make<n>other people happy?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That does sound just like you... But<n>today, we want
to do something just<n>for you, isn't that right,
Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're always doing so much<n>for us! There
must be something<n>more... selfish you
want—anything at<n>all!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see... if you two insist,<n>then, hmm... Oh, I
know just the thing!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I made a batch of pickles yesterday,<n>and I'd love to
see you munch on<n>them and rave about how
delicious<n>they are. ♪
